maya.patel: Heads-up — QA caught a regression: tokens issued during last RBAC refactor are bypassing per-route scope checks when the qa_enable_compat flag is on. Repro steps below.

jon.chen: can you paste the minimal repro and logs? trying to triage whether it's router or authz service.

maya.patel: repro:
1) issue token with scope: "embeddings:read" for route /v1/embeddings
2) call /v1/chat with that token while qa_enable_compat=true
3) request succeeds (should 403)

logs:
```
authz-service: check-scopes token_id=tok-9f3a scope=embeddings:read route=/v1/chat result=ALLOW reason="compat-fallback"
router: routed to model=gpt-embed-3 not permitted-by-policy
```

sasha: who flipped qa_enable_compat? that flag was added during the roles/permissions refactor to soften failures for older clients. sounds like fallback logic never validated route->model mapping.

ryan_li: @sasha @jon this smells like the scope grafting guard we added to support per-model scopes got skipped when token metadata is coming from KMS-wrapped rotation path. KMS rotation returns meta-less tokens for a short window.

infra-oncall: audit_bot shows no authz_event for tok-9f3a between 11:02 and 11:06 — looks like the middleware returned early. tagging SEC-4621, will put emergency canary on the flag.

audit_bot: automated-audit: token=tok-9f3a action=authz_check status=SKIPPED reason=compat_flag_true service=authz-service ts=1973123461

jon.chen: if audit logged SKIPPED we can short-circuit reproducer to ensure middleware is the one skipping. maya can you run with env DEBUG_AUTHZ=1 and paste the stack? also include header dump.

maya.patel: header dump:
```
Authorization: Bearer tok-9f3a
X-Route: /v1/chat
X-Model: gpt-embed-3
```

ryan_li: OK confirming: token metadata cache has a race during KMS unwrap/rotation — metadata (scopes/routes) might not be rehydrated before the compat_fallback check. Fix options:
- make unwrap synchronous for tokens in rotation window (hotfix)
- change compat_fallback to only apply if token metadata absent AND request from legacy-client header
- emit authz_event even when skipping so audits catch it

sasha: prefer emitting authz_event and change fallback gating. less blast radius.

maya.patel: +1 on emitting events. can we also add a regression test in authz-service that simulates KMS unwrap delay? caught this once in prod.

jon.chen: I can take the test + event emission. @ryan_li can you prototype the unwrap sync hotfix? if unwrap is blocking we need perf guard.

infra-oncall: rolling the flag to false for prod in 5m. creating oncall runbook entry: "disable qa_enable_compat if authz SKIPPED detected".

maya.patel: created ticket SEC-4621 with reproduction, logs, and proposed next steps. assigned to jon.chen + ryan_li. ETA EOD for hotfix plan.

sasha: note for postmortem: add KMS unwrap telemetry (latency histogram) and authz-event coverage for any code path that returns ALLOW.

jon.chen: ack. I'll push a minimal PR to emit SKIPPED events in authz-path and add CI test. linking here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/authz/pull/1024

ryan_li: will sketch hotfix branch and run perf tests against 500rps with synchronous unwrap. update by 17:00.

maya.patel: thanks all. will monitor after flag flip and update SEC-4621 with findings. :thumbsup:
